Governo.titolo: Definizione delle misure tecniche e organizzative del Sistema IT-Wallet
Governo.descrizione: Pubblicato il Decreto del Capo del dipartimento per la trasformazione digitale del 29 settembre 2026 di definizione delle misure tecniche e organizzative da adottarsi con riferimento ai trattamenti di dati personali effettuati nell’ambito del Sistema IT-Wallet, ai sensi dell’articolo 8, comma 5, del Dpcm 19 marzo 2026.

Governo.titolo: Giornata dell’Unità Nazionale e delle Forze armate, Palazzo Chigi si illumina con il Tricolore
Governo.descrizione: In occasione della “Giornata dell’Unità Nazionale e delle Forze armate”, dall’imbrunire della giornata odierna fino all’alba del 5 novembre 2026, la facciata principale di Palazzo Chigi sarà illuminata con il Tricolore italiano: verde, bianco e rosso, a bande verticali.

Governo.descrizione: L'intesa raggiunta su Electrolux rappresenta un passo importante nell'impegno per la tutela dell'industria italiana e dei livelli occupazionali. Oltre 100 milioni di investimenti, continuità produttiva per gli stabilimenti e uscite esclusivamente volontarie e incentivate. Governo.titolo: Giornata dell’Unità Nazionale e delle Forze armate
Governo.descrizione: Il Presidente del Consiglio, Giorgia Meloni, ha partecipato alla Cerimonia di deposizione di una corona d'alloro, da parte del Capo dello Stato, sulla Tomba del Milite Ignoto all'Altare della Patria, in occasione della Giornata dell’Unità Nazionale e delle Forze Armate.

Governo.titolo: Rinuncia della Svizzera al rimborso delle spese mediche dei feriti di Crans-Montana, la dichiarazione del Presidente Meloni
Governo.descrizione: Accolgo con grande soddisfazione la notizia, comunicatami dal Presidente Guy Parmelin, della rinuncia della Svizzera a chiedere il rimborso delle spese mediche dei feriti italiani della tragedia di Crans-Montana curati negli ospedali elvetici. Commissione, notizie.titolo: The European Commission and European Space Agency launch a joint website showcasing collaborative research on our changing planet
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The joint Earth System Science Initiative connects European research projects to better understand environmental change and provide knowledge relevant to European policies and society.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Third Implementation Dialogue on International Partnerships
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Following the "Communication for a Simpler and Faster Europe”, which strives to streamline EU laws and enhance their implementation, Commissioner Jozef Síkela will host the third Implementation Dialogue on International Partnerships on 12 November 2026.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Biomethane Mechanism: First matching round to connect buyers and suppliers
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission is launching the first matching round under the Biomethane Mechanism to bring potential buyers and suppliers of biomethane together across Europe.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Results of 04-11-2026 auction (EU-Bills)
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Auction results EU-Bills.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Eurostat: Annual fall in non-household gas prices: -6.7%
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: In the first half of 2026, the average gas price for non-household consumers in the EU was €0.06 per kilowatt-hour (kWh), up by 1.8% compared with the second half of 2025, but down 6.7% compared with the same period of 2025.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Eurostat: Non-household electricity prices fall further in 2026
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: In the first half of 2026, the average price of electricity for non-household consumers in the EU was €0.18 per kilowatt-hour (kWh).

Commissione, notizie.titolo: 2026 Enlargement Package shows that reform commitment delivers progress towards EU membership
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the European Commission adopted its annual Enlargement Package, taking stock of progress made by the enlargement partners over the past year and setting out reform priorities for the way forward.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Hospitals and healthcare social partners celebrate 20 years of social dialogue
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: For two decades, the EU Sectoral Social Dialogue Committee for Hospitals and Healthcare has delivered joint solutions to support workers, employers and resilient healthcare systems across Europe.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission strengthens Europe’s position as the world’s leading tourism destination
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The Commission presents a new EU Sustainable Tourism Strategy, to increase the sector’s competitiveness, sustainability and resilience.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission launches public consultation on making products easier to repair
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The evidence-gathering exercise is open until 9 February 2027 and will inform the impact assessment work for a possible delegated act.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Eligibility to publish in Open Research Europe without fees expands to researchers in 11 countries
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Research and innovation news alert: The new model of ORE, enabled by collective funding, brings together 16 research funding and performing organisations across Austria, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Norway, Portugal, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden and Switzerland, alongside the EC.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission takes new steps to prepare Europeans for growing crisis risks
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: As Europe faces increasingly frequent and complex crises, the European Commission is stepping up efforts to strengthen preparedness across the EU. From helping citizens protect themselves during emergencies to ensuring that national civil protection systems can keep operating when disaster strikes.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU Maritime Security Strategy: joint report highlights progress
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission and the High Representative presented today the first Joint Report on the implementation of the EU Maritime Security Strategy since 2023.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Product identifiers for e-commerce imports mandatory from 1 November 2026
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: From 1 November 2026, product identifiers (PIDs) must be declared to customs for goods sold in distance sales to buyers in the EU, notably consumers.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Bpifrance et la Commission européenne signent un accord pour accélérer les partenariats industriels de résilience et de défense entre la France et l'Ukraine
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Le 3 novembre 2026 à Paris – Le dispositif envisagé prévoit 150 M€ de garanties européennes et 13 M€ de subventions avec l'objectif de mobiliser plus de 480 M€ d'interventions financières sur trois ans et de favoriser 30 partenariats avec des startups ukrainiennes dans les technologies de défense...

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Updated EU rules on social security coordination enter into force
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The revised rules mark an important step towards fairer labour mobility and stronger protection of people’s social security rights when they live, work, retire or look for a job in another EU country.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Circularity Beyond Recycling: Can Cities Put People First?
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: For years, debates about the circular economy have focused on the production sector, reusing materials, recycling and waste management. Yet, new research suggests that this approach can unintentionally reproduce existing inequalities in cities

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU and Canada conclude negotiations on a digital trade agreement
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the European Union and Canada concluded negotiations on a landmark Digital Trade Agreement (DTA) at the EU-Canada Leaders’ Summit in Montreal.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: DG Translation in a city near you: November events
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Join one of our events in November!

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Eurostat: EU household gas prices decrease in first half of 2026
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: In the first half of 2026, average gas prices for EU households fell to €0.11 per kilowatt-hour (kWh). Prices decreased by 10.2% compared with the second semester of 2025 and by 3.5% compared with the first semester of 2025.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Eurostat: Household electricity prices ease in 1st half of 2026
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: In the first half of 2026, average electricity prices for households in the EU decreased by 2.2% to €0.28, down from €0.29 per kWh in the second half of 2025. Prices remained well above levels from before the 2022 energy crisis.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commissioner Lahbib to open the 9th European Civil Protection Forum
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Commissioner Hadja Lahbib, will open the 9th edition of the European Civil Protection Forum, taking place on 3 and 4 November. The Forum will bring together high-level representatives, civil protection professionals, first responders and experts from Europe and beyond to discuss crisis preparedness.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission approves additional €212 million French State aid for agricultural and aquaculture companies facing increased fuel prices
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has approved a €212 million budget increase and an extension of the eligibility period for a French State aid scheme for agricultural and aquaculture companies facing increased fuel prices due to the Middle East crisis.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission launches High-Level Dialogue with the European refining sector
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission launched the first High-Level Dialogue with the European refining industry to discuss how to strengthen Europe’s energy security, defence readiness and industrial competitiveness in a rapidly changing geopolitical environment.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Europeans overwhelmingly support stronger EU civil protection cooperation, new Eurobarometer shows
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Europeans continue to show strong support for a coordinated EU approach to disaster preparedness and response, mutual assistance between countries, and further strengthening Europe’s capacity to prepare for and response to future crises, according to the Special Eurobarometer on EU civil protection.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Energy Transition Investment Council - Call for applications
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has launched a 4-week call for applications for membership of the newly established Energy Transition Investment Council (ETIC) expert group and its National Promotional Banks and Institution (NPBI) and International Financial Institution (IFI) Coordination sub-group.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission takes a key step forward on 2027 financial support for Ukraine
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the European Commission took another step in the implementation of the €90 billion Ukraine Support Loan,  which will provide Ukraine with essential budgetary support and defence products in 2026 and 2027.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission publishes the 2027 version of the Combined Nomenclature
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has published the latest version of the Combined Nomenclature (CN), which will apply from 1 January 2027.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission acts against imports of PET Spunbond from China
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today the European Commission imposed anti-dumping duties on imports into the EU of polyethylene terephthalate (PET) Spunbond from the People’s Republic of China.
